notes.title: Devlog #2
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
Some of you might think the project is abandoned or something.. but it's not.
Last summer I refactorized the entire game.
Since then I started adding new content.
I won't show everything now because I (hopefully) will release another devlog and the demo/Prologue in February.

Here is a short list with what the features I already added or are work in progress:

[h3]Let's start with the "Renovation" part:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Breakable furniture like benches and metal cabinets
[*] Paintable walls - choose what paint to use either from the paint buckets or from UI
[*] Floors and ceilings have a texture for now, but later will replace it with a proper wooden floor model or something
[*] Trash - can be collected, as the broken parts from furniture, and earn some money when putting in the trash bin
[/list]

[h3]Now regarding the shop:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Buy fruniture like shelves and place them inside the shop from the laptop
[*] Place objects either on walls (ex paintings) or on the shelves
[*] Receive customers - not all customers who enter the shop will buy an item or items
[*] Meet customers at the checkout:
[*] - if they want to buy something, take the money and give change (if any)
[*] - if they want to sell something, inspect the item and if you decide to buy it, pay them
[/list]

[h3]As you know, the game has a deposit auctions part:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Now all NPCs can talk using different voices and can do it dynamically, depending on the current bid
[*] The items inside the deposits are now based on your level (you won't find Mona Lisa inside a 5$ deposit :D ). And the starting price of the deposit is based on the value of the deposit (there's a chance to start at 5-30% of the value)
[/list]
You can go to an auction by using the laptop, where you will also pay a small fee.

Now for the work in progress features:
[list]
[*] Online auctions (for items, not deposits)
[*] Dirty objects restoration (working for coins already, but I want to add different items too)
[*] Broken objects restoration
[*] Online shop for used parts (needed to repair broken objects)
[*] Online market to sell objects
[/list]

All the items or furniture bought online will arrive in boxes.

notes.title: Devlog #1
notes.content:

Below I will present the current state of the game.

[b]Renovate the store by:[/b]
[olist]
[*] Cleaning the floor
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880014/118cb5b771f604154d29818f845670065b1c82f8.gif[/img]

This is what it's planned for the next devlog:
[olist]
[*] Online auctions
[*] Objects restauration (removing dirt or rust from old/bad objects)
[*] Adding "unknown" to market value of some objects, so you need to go to an appraiser/evaluator
[*] Adding an appraiser/evaluator :D
[*] Adding more types of shelves
[*] Adding more items and 2-3 conditions for each (new, used, bad)
[*] Daily expenses (ads, electricity)
[*] Card payment
[*] Adding a tool for floors and ceilings (now I use the brush)
[*] + others
[/olist]

Best regards,
Cristian
